title: Productivity & Workflow Engine
subtitle: Full-Stack Task & Systems Orchestration
headline: High-performance web system designed for complex multi-tier project tracking and deterministic state.
summary: An independent full-stack web platform engineered to demonstrate scalable system architecture, type-safe APIs, and responsive interface design without third-party template bloat.
whatWasBuilt: Full-stack application featuring server-side rendering, responsive component architecture, secure authentication sessions, and high-performance relational database schema.
technicalChallenge: Managing dense real-time state across multiple nested workboards without client rendering lag, memory leaks, or unthrottled DOM mutations.
architecturalSolution: Engineered a streamlined application utilizing Next.js App Router, TypeScript, and a relational PostgreSQL database with deterministic optimistic mutations and strict boundary validation.
highlights: End-to-end type safety across API boundaries and client state
Sub-second page rendering with minimal client runtime overhead
Relational schema design with transactional data integrity
Modular design system with zero third-party visual component dependencies

title: Real-Time Operational Analytics
subtitle: Data Aggregation & Telemetry Console
headline: Low-latency administrative telemetry console transforming raw event streams into clear operational views.
summary: A high-efficiency data intelligence console designed to handle continuous event ingestion and render real-time operational analytics without UI stutter or memory bloat.
whatWasBuilt: Operational analytics dashboard featuring SVG-rendered metrics, time-series data aggregation, configurable filter matrices, and secure role-based access control.
technicalChallenge: Processing continuous high-frequency telemetry events on client browsers without dropping frames or freezing interactive chart canvases.
architecturalSolution: Implemented web worker thread isolation for mathematical computations and hardware-accelerated SVG projections, maintaining steady 60fps rendering across data spikes.
highlights: Hardware-accelerated SVG charts rendering thousands of points at 60fps
Web worker background computation for client-side aggregation
Zero-latency multi-tier filter state query serialization
Strict data sanitization and deterministic state replay

title: Cross-Platform Mobile Application
subtitle: Mobile Architecture & Offline Sync
headline: Offline-first mobile application built for fluid user interaction, local ledger queueing, and resilient state.
summary: A cross-platform mobile product built by the founding developer to test and prove offline-first data synchronization, intuitive gesture navigation, and robust state persistence.
whatWasBuilt: Native-feel client application with local storage persistence, gesture-driven navigation, and background data synchronization pipelines.
technicalDirection: Built with React Native and typed API backends, focusing on resilient error recovery and predictable offline-first operation.
technicalChallenge: Mobile products often fail when network connectivity drops intermittently, creating lost form states, sync conflicts, and poor user trust in remote environments.
architecturalSolution: Constructed a local-first mobile client using React Native with an embedded SQLite ledger and a deterministic queue. When network connectivity restores, state updates sync with a typed Node.js backend with conflict resolution.
highlights: Local-first SQLite data persistence with zero-latency input response
Deterministic sync queue with automatic retry and rollback capability
Unified cross-platform UI targeting iOS and Android form factors
End-to-end typed Remote Procedure Call (RPC) integration
